title: Guided construction of single cell reference for human and mouse lung

materials_reviewed.notes: Full text parsed from PDF and review_md. LungMAP CellRef extension dictionary thoroughly checked.
CellRef guided construction pipeline, cluster stability assessment metrics (iLISI), and annotation methods reviewed.
Fig. 1 (workflow), Fig. 2 (Human Lung CellRef 48 types), Fig. 3 (Mouse Lung Development CellRef), Figs. 4-6 checked.
Supplementary Data 2 and online LungMAP CellCards dictionary cross-referenced.

cluster_inventory: 48 human lung cell types (including deuterosomal, suprabasal, SVEC, maDC, platelets, SMG duct, RAS, AT1, iMON, etc.)
Mouse lung development cell populations (AT1/AT2, distal epithelial progenitors, EPCs, etc.)
